Neo.public_notes: Not available yet. Features built on Neo, such as Neo tasks, aren't available either.

Deployments.public_notes: There's no Pulumi-hosted runner pool. Deployments run on [customer-managed agents](/docs/administration/concepts/customer-managed-runners/) that you register to an agent pool, and so do discovery scans and policy evaluations. Terraform remote execution and module conversion aren't supported.

Drift Detection.public_notes: Off by default. Contact Pulumi support to turn it on. Scheduled drift runs and automatic remediation also need Deployments set up. You can always detect drift from the CLI with `pulumi refresh --preview-only`.

Context API (graph query).public_notes: Needs a self-hosted release from late October 2026 or later, and the [OpenSearch cluster](/docs/administration/self-hosting/components/search/) that resource search uses.

Terraform - Remote Execution.public_notes: Not available yet. Workspaces set to remote execution run locally instead.

Terraform - State Backend.public_notes: Set `PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN` to a hostname of its own, separate from `PULUMI_API_DOMAIN`, and use that hostname in place of `tf.pulumi.com`.

Terraform Module Registry.public_notes: Not available yet, so modules can't be published to the registry or converted into Pulumi packages.
